name: Gauge dial
summary: A 180° dial: a needle sweeps to the value over a toned arc, big center readout.

slots.label: How far round
slots.tooltip: Where the needle stops, from 0 (far left, empty) to 1 (far right, full). 0.73 means 73% of the way round

slots.label: Readout
slots.tooltip: The big number written under the needle, like 73% or 92°C

slots.label: Caption
slots.tooltip: A short line under the readout that says what the dial measures

props.label: Colour
props.tooltip: The colour of the arc, the needle and the readout
